query:
query MarketHistory(
  $marketId: String!,
  $startDate: String,
  $endDate: String,
  $interval: MarketHistoryInterval
) {
  analytics {
    marketHistory(
      marketId: $marketId,
      startDate: $startDate,
      endDate: $endDate,
      interval: $interval
    ) {
      timestamp
      supply
      supplyInUsd
      borrow
      borrowInUsd
      liquidity
      liquidityInUsd
      debtRepaid
      debtRepaidInUsd
      interestAccrued
      interestAccruedInUsd
      interestRepaid
      interestRepaidInUsd
      borrowApr
      supplyApy
      utilizationPercentage
      loanOriginationFees
      loanOriginationFeesInUsd
      loanOriginationFeesMinAda
      loanOriginationFeesMinAdaInUsd
    }
  }
}
